seo.description: Paul Perigault, cloud DevOps apprentice at WeVii and student at ESIEA Paris: CI/CD pipelines, Terraform, Kubernetes, GitOps with ArgoCD, AWS and GCP.

hero.school: Engineering cycle at ESIEA Paris · WeVii
hero.summary: Paul Perigault is a cloud DevOps apprentice at WeVii and an engineering student at ESIEA Paris. He builds CI/CD pipelines, AWS and GCP infrastructure with Terraform and Kubernetes, and GitOps deployments with ArgoCD.
